title: Chef John's Parker House Rolls
description: Classic fold-over dinner rolls from an egg-enriched dough with a full stick of butter in it, plus more brushed on before folding and after baking.

notes: Reference split: 24 rolls, matching the recipe yield.

Assumes 120 g flour per cup (540 g total), whole milk at 122 g per ½ cup, a 7 g yeast packet, 50 g per large egg, 12.5 g sugar per tbsp, and 14.2 g butter per tbsp. Extra flour added while kneading is not counted.
Counts all 12 tbsp butter as eaten: 8 in the dough, 4 brushed before folding and after baking. Water and salt add no macros.

ingredients.label: Whole milk
ingredients.sourceLabel: USDA SR28, NDB 01077: MILK,WHL,3.25% MILKFAT,W/ ADDED VITAMIN D

ingredients.label: Active dry yeast
ingredients.sourceLabel: USDA SR28, NDB 18375: LEAVENING AGENTS,YEAST,BAKER'S,ACTIVE DRY

items.note: Diamond Crystal; source doesn't say which brand
melted; before folding and after baking

directions.title: Bloom the yeast
directions.text: Warm milk, warm water and yeast go in the stand mixer bowl. Let it sit 10 minutes.

directions.title: Mix and knead
directions.text: Add the eggs, sugar, salt and the 8 tbsp melted butter and whisk the wet stuff together. Dump in the flour and knead with the dough hook (or by hand) until it comes together into a ball, 5 to 6 minutes. Add a little more flour only if it's not coming together.

directions.title: Bulk rise
directions.text: Into a lightly buttered bowl, covered, until doubled, about 2 hours. Watch the dough, not the clock; move on as soon as it's doubled.

directions.title: Divide
directions.text: Press the dough flat. Weigh the whole thing, divide the grams by 24, and portion each piece to that weight. Roll each into a smooth ball.

directions.title: Shape
directions.text: Line a sheet pan with a Silpat or parchment. On a lightly floured surface, roll each ball into an oval 4 to 5 inches long, brush the top with some of the brushing butter, and fold it in half. Press the fold down firmly.

directions.title: Proof
directions.text: Arrange on the sheet in 6 rows of 4. Cover with a clean towel and let rise somewhere warm until almost doubled, about 1 hour.

directions.title: Bake
directions.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Bake until golden brown on top, about 25 minutes.

directions.title: Butter
directions.text: Brush the tops with the rest of the melted butter while they're still warm.

notes: The source page says "350 degrees C (175 degrees C)". It's a typo: 350°F = 175°C.
A lightly pressed fold can pop open during the final proof.

log.entry: First bake, for the trial Thanksgiving. Bulk rise was doubled at about 1.5 hours, so moved on early.
